:::{#exm-sensitivity}
#### Sensitivity of a COVID-19 test

Suppose a COVID-19 test is [positive](#def-positive-classification) for 99% of the people who have COVID-19.
Let $D$ be the event "the person has COVID-19"
and $\posclass$ the event "the test is positive".
Then the test's sensitivity (@def-sensitivity) is:

$$\Pr(\posclass \mid D) = 0.99$$ {#eq-sensitivity-exm}

:::
